title: Rundeck: Eclipse Jetty's `SessionAuthentication` retains authentication credentials in a serializable object…
description: A security vulnerability exists in the Rundeck package where Eclipse Jetty's SessionAuthentication component retains authentication credentials within a serializable object. This could potentially expose sensitive authentication data. The issue affects Rundeck versions prior to 6.0.1-r11. A fix is available in version 6.0.1-r11. The vulnerability has a medium severity rating with a CVSS score of 5.6.
